name: Arrears
effect: Drains 5% of your score every 3 seconds while it sits on the board
notes: Cannot be discarded or swapped. The pure-pressure one. Only leaves by being played.

name: Due Today
effect: Wears a real rank and plays like an ordinary card
notes: The only Notice that is also a playable card. Good first one to build.

name: Quota Card
effect: Clears itself and pays credits
notes: Reads a counter the round already keeps, so it needs no new hook. Same trick CHALLENGE_DEFS uses.

name: Under Review
effect: Clears and pays
on_fail: Escalates, then spreads to a new neighbour every 20s
notes: The spreading one. Needs a cap or it can eat a board. Owner: is boss-only safer?

name: Hands On Deck
effect: Clears
notes: handsPlayedRound is bumped AFTER scoring, so inside calcScore the current hand is the (n+1)th.

name: Clear the Desk
effect: Clears and pays credits
notes: Demands an ACTION rather than a score. Reads best because the answer is visible on the board.

name: Shuffle Seating
effect: Clears
notes: Must be swappable, so cardCan must allow swap. Contrast Arrears.

name: Cross-Training
effect: Clears and buffs the cards used
notes: Works in Spectrum: a colour flush is still a flush.

name: Reassignment
effect: Becomes an ordinary card carrying +10 permanent pips
notes: The payoff Notice. Timer is in ROUNDS, not seconds. Proves the timer column needs a unit.

name: Probation
effect: Becomes a wild card for one hand
notes: Timer counted in ACTIONS. swapsUsedRound already exists.

name: Escalated
effect: The cell is inert
notes: What a failed Notice leaves behind. Never offered, only created. Route via isCellBlocked and every existing guard covers it.

name: The Temp Pool
effect: All five become the same random rank; one gets a 10s rewind, one 10 credits, one +30 pips, one a replay, one a forced Trick
notes: Owner's five-card idea. Makes Five of a Kind reachable outside Spectrum. Accrued time must survive the card leaving and returning.

name: Reorganisation
effect: Pick three cards from your deck; they draw first next round
notes: The draw-order event. Needs EVENT_REQUIRES so it is never offered with a tiny deck.

name: Temp Agency
effect: This Sleight and its whole row become Temp copies of the best rank on the board
notes: STRONGEST IDEA IN THE LIST. A row of Aces is a Five/Six/Seven of a Kind. Capped by HAND_MAX_CARDS = 7.

name: Carbon Copy
effect: The card above it becomes a Temp copy of the card below it
notes: The small version of Temp Agency. Good for proving _temp before building the row one.

name: Floor Plan
effect: Discards the 3x3 centred on it
notes: removeAndFall already takes an arbitrary cell list, so this is nearly free.

name: Fire Drill
effect: Discards a random 3x3 anywhere on the board
notes: RENAMED. 'Spot Check' is already a reward-grid penalty (BAL.spot_check).

name: Neighbourhood
effect: Every card touching it scores +8 pips
notes: 8-way matters: two swapped cells share no orthogonal neighbour at all (the trap Pivot hit).

name: Team Lead
effect: Every card touching it takes +1 permanent mult
notes: Say 'scores +1 mult when played', not 'permanently gains'. Flat vs scaling wording rule, r209.

name: Department
effect: Its whole row scores +6 mult
notes: Gets its line visual free on the play board AND the reward grid.

name: Open Plan
effect: Its column may be selected non-adjacently
notes: RISKIEST ONE HERE. Touches connectivity, which findBestHand, the preview and auto-submit all read.

name: Standing Order
effect: Forces the Trick in tray slot 1
notes: Needs trayTrickAt(n), the one missing helper. Understudy already does this shape for priming.

name: Closing Shift
demand: Your first hand of the round
effect: Forces the LAST Trick in your tray
notes: Makes tray ORDER a live decision, which turns the Tray Order event into a tool.

name: Delegate
effect: Forces the Trick in the tray slot matching this Sleight's column
notes: Board position selects a Trick. Only entity that would link the two.

name: All Hands
effect: Forces your lowest-tier Trick
notes: Only ever draw from forceableTrickIds(). 92 of 176 Tricks can force; the rest pay nothing.

name: Performance Review
effect: Forces whichever Trick paid you least last round
notes: Needs last round's ledger kept past the reset. Everything else here is free.

name: Peak Hours
effect: Forces a random Trick instead of the usual max-Focus payout
notes: Any Focus drop must be deferred ~260ms so the fill animation plays first.

name: Pass It On
effect: Primes the Trick to its right in the tray
notes: Priming cannot fire a Trick whose condition was unmet. That is what priming IS; use force for the other.

name: Cross-Reference
effect: Primes a random Trick

name: Mentorship
effect: Primes the Trick you have owned longest
notes: Needs an acquisition order, which acquiredTricks already gives for free.

name: Preferred Vendor
effect: The last card you scored draws sooner for the rest of the run
notes: A BIAS: weighted sort at shuffle time. Never substitute at the draw (the r216 Famine lesson).

name: Expedite
effect: Put any card in your deck on top of the pile, now
notes: A TUTOR: deterministic and one-shot, so the player can plan a turn around it. Different feel from a bias.

name: Filing System
effect: Your highest and lowest cards both draw sooner
notes: Must show the bias somewhere or nobody will believe it works.

name: Backlog
effect: Discarded cards go to the back of the pile, twice over
notes: A BURY, the inverse lever. Famine is already a fleet-wide bury.

name: Seniority
effect: Every Ace you score gains permanent draw bias
notes: Spectrum has no Aces, so it must be in NUMERIC_BANNED_TRICKS.

name: Contagion
effect: Plants a Notice somewhere on the board
notes: The boss that USES the Notice engine. Build after the engine, not with it.

name: The Shredder
effect: Your three highest cards are buried at the back of the draw pile
notes: Reorders the real pile. Must not forge or rewrite cards.

name: Night Shift
effect: +30s on the clock
notes: Both outcomes go through rewindTime/pauseRound, never a raw roundSeconds write.

name: Audit Trail
demand: Clear the goal with a Notice still alive
effect: Bonus credits
notes: Failing a challenge must never fail the ROUND. Clear the raised goal and the round passes.

name: Severance
effect: Clears every Escalated cell on the board and pays 10 credits
notes: Counterplay, Clean Slate's shape. A permanent liability needs a way off or it is just attrition.
